Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are an infant presenting with recurrent episodes of stridor and wheezing; please inform me, or your guardian, what specifically triggers these breathing difficulties, such as feeding, crying, or lying down.

REQUEST TEST: Pulse_Oximetry, Heart_Rate, Respiratory_Rate.
REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count, C-Reactive_Protein.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Heart_Rate: 110 bpm, Respiratory_Rate: 30 breaths/min; NORMAL READINGS for Pulse_Oximetry, Complete_Blood_Count, C-Reactive_Protein.

speaker: Doctor
text:
The vitals and inflammatory markers are currently normal. Can you describe exactly what happens during the episodes of stridor and wheezing? Do they occur during feeding, when the baby is crying, or when lying flat?

REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray
REQUEST IMAGES: Chest_X-Ray

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Chest_X-Ray Findings: Evidence of tracheal compression and a vascular ring suggestive of a double aortic arch

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Double Aortic Arch causing tracheal compression and stridor.
